description: Go-produced vectors (pkg/evm/stawi) for packages/finance_sdk verifyRoomCall: every room call a member's device signs (settlement PrepareRoomCall). typed_hash = keccak256(abi.encode(typehash, verifier, chainId, member, nonce, deadline) ++ params) (Call.TypedHash) and digest = AccountWrappedHash(member, chainId, typed_hash). builder and inputs are what the person chose, as the Dart RoomCallExpected factory of that name takes them; verifier_role names the room contract (finance Room.governance_address or custody_address) the call must go to. The *_payloads sections are the proposal payload hashes a PROPOSE carries (RoomCustody memberActionPayloadHash, rolePayloadHash, CancelPrincipalExitPayloadHash, joinPolicyPayloadHash, setRoomBinding) and freeze_reasons the reason hash a FREEZE signs.
